string.text: Half caravan guards, half trained soldiers. Puts off most bandits.
Caravan guards backed by veteran elite troops. Only a real army will take it on.
Local caravan guards. Enough to scare off looters, but not much more.
Arrange a shipment to one of your workshops
You have no shipments on the road.
You don't own a workshop in another town that isn't at war with you.
You can't send a shipment to {DEST} any more.
You already have {MAX} shipments on the road.
You can't afford the carter's fee.
The warehouse in {DEST} doesn't have room for all of it. Whatever doesn't fit will be sold at the market there.
Warehouse space left: {FREE} of {CAPACITY}. Your cargo weighs {WEIGHT}.
Choose the workshop town. The cargo goes into your warehouse there. Hover over a town to see how much room its warehouse has.
A bigger escort costs more but makes the caravan a harder target. Hover over an escort to see who is in it.
On the road, going to sell the cargo
Your shipment of {COUNT} items has left {ORIGIN} for {DEST}. It should get there in {TIME}.
Your shipment can't reach a warehouse of yours any more. It is heading to {DEST} to sell the cargo.
Your shipment to {OLD} can't deliver there any more. It is heading to your warehouse in {DEST} instead.
Your shipment reached {DEST}. {STORED} items were put in your warehouse.
Your shipment reached {DEST}. The cargo ({SOLD} items) was sold for {GOLD}{GOLD_ICON}.
Your shipment reached {DEST}. {STORED} items were put in your warehouse; {SOLD} didn't fit and were sold for {GOLD}{GOLD_ICON}.
Your shipment to {DEST} was taken by {ENEMY}.
Turn the mod on or off.
What every shipment costs before weight and distance are added.
Fee per weight unit per 100 distance
Added to the cost for each unit of cargo weight, for every 100 units of map distance to the workshop.
Shipments on the road at once
How many of your shipments can be travelling at the same time.
In "Check shipments on the road", also show which settlement each shipment is near.
Caravan guards in the cheapest escort, plus one caravan master. It costs nothing on top of the fee.
Men in the middle escort, plus one caravan master. Half are caravan guards, half are trained soldiers of the town's culture.
Added to the shipment cost when you hire the armed escort.
Men in the strongest escort, plus one caravan master. A third are caravan guards, the rest are veteran elite troops of the town's culture.
Added to the shipment cost when you hire the veteran escort.
Show chat messages about what the mod is doing. Useful for checking the mod works; turn it off for normal play.
